name: FlareVentEventLog
tagline: Every flare and vent event logged, reportable events notified on time, monthly volumes inside the permit.
description: A complete flaring and venting register for oil & gas facilities in one PCF control: log events with source, cause, category, start/end and volume; automatic duration, reportability against your thresholds and agency notification countdown; root cause before close; timeline by facility; monthly totals against permit limits with a screening CO2e estimate.
features: Demo mode with 51 fictional events at 5 facilities
Ongoing events with End event workflow
Reportable rules: volume, duration, emergency, override
Agency notification deadline countdown and overdue flags
Root cause and corrective action required to close non-routine events
Monthly totals vs permit limits and six-month matrix
Bulk status moves, CSV export, delete with undo
